name: Brecht Hallan
found: Main Jetty at dawn, counting boats out.
sayings: The lake gives. Don't ask what it takes.
wants: A good season and the compact honoured quietly.
dreams: To pass the fleet and the secret to a worthy heir, and die on the water.
oddly_also: Commands forty-odd boats; inherited the lizard-man secret from his father.
family: Hallan patriarch; forty and more kin.
